prompt:
Flat sumi-e ink wash painting on aged warm paper. Hand-painted, not rendered. A single isolated subject on plain paper, centred, whole subject in frame. Dark tapering brush outline, flat even ink-wash fill, uniform ambient tone with no visible light source, no cast shadow, no sheen. Monochromatic warm grey from pale paper to near-black ink. Brush character at every edge.

Subject: one tall free-standing chunk of cliff rock, like a single pillar of the cliff wall in the reference image, redrawn alone and seen slightly from one corner so that two of its faces show. About twice as tall as it is wide. One solid mass with a broken, uneven, jagged contour: an irregular notched top, chipped corners, a few deep vertical cracks and dark ink crevices. Mid-grey wash faces of even tone, the tone varying only by brush wash and never by lighting. No horizontal strata bands, no layers, no stripes. No trees, no path, no gate.

Plain empty paper background and nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no cliff wall, no mist, no clouds, no shadow, no text, no seal. Whole subject in frame with a paper margin all round.
